recordings.unit_evidence: https://opensimconfluence.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OpenSim/pages/53089415 (legacy .mot angles are degrees; time is seconds)
recordings.source_format: SIMM/OpenSim .mot, 211 rows, time range 0.5 to 4.0 seconds
preprocessing: Parse whitespace .mot after endheader and export required channels to CSV
Subtract first time (0.5 s); retain nominal 60 Hz timestamps rounded to milliseconds in the source
Negate both knee angles for positive flexion; retain hip and ankle signs
No interpolation, filtering, time stretching or invented contralateral data
recordings.license_note: Official OpenSim-distributed example. No separate motion-file license appears in this repository; do not assume the software license covers data.

recordings.subject: subject02
recordings.units_evidence: Source header explicitly states inDegrees=yes and SI units: seconds, metres, degrees for angles
recordings.preprocessing: Leg export selects six bilateral angles and negates knees. Full-body export retains all native coordinate names/signs. Time zeroed; original spacing preserved. No filtering, mirroring or time warping.
recordings.limitations: Official IK example, not an additional independent population dataset. Native torso/arm coordinates require retargeting; not simulation validated. No separate motion-file license established in repository.

not_training_ready: Continuous trials are not single seamless cycles. No active configs changed. No human-model retargeting or simulation stability validation performed.

screened_sources.reason: Marker-based archive contains .trc marker positions, not joint angles. Requires a validated IK pipeline; do not rename coordinates as angles.

conversion_review.details: Rechecked author code/model archive: supplied 2392_2024_model.osim and marker preprocessing scripts. TRC can be fitted to the supplied model, with subject scaling and marker residual checks. OpenSim IK is not installed here; no reconstruction performed.

screened_sources.reason: Inspected Sub7_Kinematics_T3.csv is a Vicon marker-trajectory section, not six joint-angle signals. Original candidate retained under runs/motion_dataset_search_20261114.

conversion_review.details: Inspected Matlab code/MAIN_KineticsKinematics.m: loads rawMechanics and static markers, calls AnglesCalibration, AltitudeDynamic/RotationCalculation and produces bilateral hip/knee/ankle plus pelvic angles. Port or execute author pipeline, retaining native physical time before cycle normalization; confirm each file sampling rate.

screened_sources.reason: Angles are degrees and bilateral, but time is 0-100% gait phase, not seconds. Physical duration was not verified; no invented duration.

conversion_review.details: Official UCI documentation confirms degrees and 101 points per cycle. Pivoting to bilateral CSV is possible, but seconds cannot be recovered from phase alone without original stride durations.

screened_sources.reason: Paper focuses exclusively on the leading limb per trial. Simultaneous bilateral channels and physical timestamps not verified.

conversion_review.details: Format conversion is possible if data supplied, but leading-limb-only trials cannot be converted into simultaneous bilateral recordings. Need inspect downloadable workbook and original timing before acceptance.

screened_sources.reason: Two protocols downloaded and fully verified for angles/time; neither is claimed as an exact mini-hurdle/quick-step match.

conversion_review.details: Six trials already converted. Squat segment-transform MAT downloaded; SciPy exposes MCOS table as opaque. Need table decoder or MATLAB export; not inherently unconvertible.

screened_sources.reason: Agility-ladder CSV description lists elbows, shoulders, knees and hips; ankle angles not established.

conversion_review.details: Existing CSV can be parsed, but listed joint fields omit ankles. Ankle reconstruction would require suitable source landmarks/video and validation, not a format change.

screened_sources.reason: Hurdle study says processed data/code are available from authors upon request, not public downloads; no contact initiated.

conversion_review.details: Need access to original processed files before evaluating conversion. Published figures alone are not equivalent to raw trajectories.

screened_sources.reason: Broad obstacle-locomotion theme; exact quick-step protocol not established. BVH rotations would require verified anatomical-axis mapping, not arbitrary Euler-channel renaming.

conversion_review.details: BVH contains full-body local rotations and frame timing. CSV export possible; anatomical flexion requires forward kinematics, rest-pose/axis calibration, then retargeting or IK. Native Euler channels cannot simply be relabelled.

screened_sources.title: Three-Dimensional Kinematic and Kinetic behavior of the Pelvic Rotation in Mini-Hurdle Sprint: Comparisons to Normal Sprint
screened_sources.evidence: Publisher describes twelve sprinters and mini-hurdle sprinting; article lists Supplementary material (0). Raw bilateral hip/knee/ankle trajectories and physical timestamps are not supplied on the article page.
screened_sources.next_action: Obtain the original bilateral angle/time files from the authors or identify another publicly downloadable matching release; no contact sent.

conversion_review.details: Exact mini-hurdle protocol found; publisher lists no supplementary raw files. Conversion cannot reconstruct absent trajectories from summary statistics.

screened_sources.reason: Author README advertises degrees and seven IMU channels, but visualization_tool.py explicitly treats angles relative to vertical and draws segment orientations. Anatomical joint-angle conversion requires calibration/sign validation; do not use raw columns as flexion.

conversion_review.details: IMU orientations relative to vertical can potentially yield planar joint angles via adjacent-segment differences. Need mounting offsets, sign conventions and validation, including pelvis/foot reference definitions.

screened_sources.reason: Public description lists toe clearance and approach-distance outcomes, not six continuous bilateral joint angles. File API returned HTTP 403; no claim of file-level verification.

conversion_review.details: Published description emphasizes toe-clearance scalars. Inspect actual accessible files before claiming joint trajectories exist; earlier API request was denied.

screened_sources.reason: All 6882 JointAngle MOT files from all 12 archives converted; see gait120/manifest.json.
